display_name: Seizure window risk (tabular band-power, classical baseline)

input_contract.population: Single-patient (CHB-MIT chb01) continuous scalp EEG, 23-channel standard placement, 256 Hz.

quality_constraints.signal: 23-channel EEG sampled at 256 Hz, standard CHB-MIT montage; non-overlapping 4-second windows.

temporal_validation: not applicable — cross-sectional window profile, no outcome time or horizon

calibration.note: Single chronological-split run (2026-08-29): balanced accuracy 0.875, sensitivity 0.75, specificity 1.0. Nested paired evaluation could not run at this class rarity (18/2700 positive). Not calibration-assessed at production scale.

safety.disclaimer: Research window-level risk estimate, not a seizure diagnosis and not an epilepsy diagnosis.
limitations: Classifies individual 4-second EEG windows as seizure/non-seizure; it does NOT yet reconstruct full seizure event intervals (onset/offset/latency) as the condition's primary task requires.
Trained and evaluated on a SINGLE patient (CHB-MIT chb01), 3 hours of recording, 2 seizures, 18 of 2700 windows positive (0.67% prevalence). Not validated across patients or sites.
Extreme class imbalance means metrics are unstable; treat point estimates as indicative only.
CHB-MIT seizure labels reflect one center's expert annotation protocol; not a general epilepsy diagnosis.
No site-held-out or cross-patient external validation was possible with a single patient's data.

No EDF/signal ingestion adapter exists in the platform layer yet — a live case bundle with a raw EEG asset currently routes to 'incompatible' ('requires signal; not present in this case') rather than being scored. This model is benchmark-only via the offline evaluation pipeline until that adapter is built.

model_card.intended_use: Research benchmarking of a classical classifier on EEG band-power features, as a first step toward full seizure event detection.
model_card.excluded_use: Any clinical use. Epilepsy diagnosis. Seizure detection or intervention in a real monitoring setting.
model_card.training_population: 2700 non-overlapping 4-second windows from 3 hours of chb01's scalp EEG (CHB-MIT); 18 positive (0.67%).
model_card.evaluation_population: Chronological holdout of the same single-patient recording (later windows held out).
model_card.label_policy: Window overlaps an expert-annotated seizure interval from chb01-summary.txt.

data_sources.label: CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database (chb01)
data_sources.citation: Shoeb, A. Application of Machine Learning to Epileptic Seizure Onset Detection and Treatment. PhD thesis, MIT, 2009.

data_licenses: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (PhysioNet) — verified, permissive, redistribution permitted with attribution
model_card.explanation_method: input_sensitivity over the 4 ANOVA-selected band-power features

reuse_manifest.preprocessing_assumptions: non-overlapping 4s windows; Welch PSD; 5 standard EEG bands
reuse_manifest.io_contract: raw EDF + seizure interval list -> numeric CSV

reuse_manifest.paper_citation: Shoeb, MIT PhD thesis 2009; Goldberger et al., PhysioNet, Circulation 2000

reuse_manifest.io_contract: EDF + summary annotation text -> raw signal + seizure intervals
